name: toggle_auto_import_events
description:
Turn automatic calendar event import on or off for the user's Sunsama account. Use this only when the user asks to change that setting by name; it is not a way to import a single event or to read the calendar.

WRITE — CONFIRM FIRST. This changes a persistent account setting, not one item. Turning it on starts continuous ingestion of calendar events into Sunsama and keeps running until it is turned off; turning it off stops synchronisation the user may be relying on, and already imported events stay where they are. Say which direction you are about to change and what follows from it, and get explicit approval.
